**Handover Command carries each session's transfer**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / UE Mobility Management Procedures / Handover Preparation |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 15s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Owns | N2 handover preparation |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.4.1.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: the intra-system "shall include" sentence is added in V15.5.0; before it V15.0.0 has a PDU Session Resource Subject to Forwarding List (0..1), V15.1.0 to V15.3.0 a mandatory PDU Session Resource Handover List, and V15.4.0 the list as 0..1 with no obligation in the text; the cited sentences are unchanged Rel-16 through Rel-19)
- TS 38.413 9.2.3.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: Handover Command Transfer is O per item in V15.0.0 and M from V15.1.0; Rel-18: "subclause 9.3.4.10" reads "clause 9.3.4.10" from Rel-18 (editorial))
- TS 38.413 9.3.4.10 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: UL forwarding and additional tunnels are added within Rel-15; every IE of the transfer is optional in every version read; Rel-16: adds the Data Forwarding Response E-RAB List; Rel-19: the QoS Flow Failed to Setup List is present by V19.4.0)
- TS 38.413 9.1.1 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-HANDOVER-COMMAND-TRANSFER.md).
